claims.text: USA vs Russia: How Much Tax Revenue Comes From Income?
The United States relies on income and profit taxes for 93% of its tax revenue, while Russia gets just 14.4% from income taxes.
The United States gets 93% of tax revenue from income, while Russia gets 14.4%.
That total counts taxes payable on actual or presumed incomes, profits, and capital gains.
claims.support: Taxes on income, profits, and capital gains are taxes payable on the actual or presumed incomes, profits and capital gains.

claims.text: Side by side, America relies heavily on income, getting 6.5 times the share Russia collects.
Across the globe, the median country gets 38% of tax revenue from income, with China close by at 37.2%.
Canada takes 78.5% and Australia 76.6%, while the UK takes 52.6% and Germany 45.2%.
